zh: 改善切换模型时模型名的样子：名字在原地换成新模型名，离开的名字向上穿过一层模糊，新名字从下方升上来，两段文字同时站在座位框里，座位宽度随两段中较宽的一段过渡；选了减弱动效时名字直接换过去。
en: Improve how the model's name changes when another model is picked: the name swaps in place — the words leaving rise through a blur while the new name comes up from below, both standing in the seat box at once, with the seat travelling to the wider of the two as it runs; with reduced motion the name simply changes.
